biography.value:
Description

A cat fairy who turned evil due to human society's negative influence. It raises its allies' strength with the power of money, and can hinder enemies with his enfeebling spells.

Defense

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +5 natural, +1 dodge)

hp 82 [120] (15d6+20)

mp 85

Fort +7, Ref +12, Will +12

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Fly 60 ft. (average)

Melee +1 Quarterstaff +8 (1d6+1)

Special Attacks Pay to Play, Telekinetic

Spells Known (FC CL 15th [19th for enfeebling]; concentration +20 [+24 for enfeebling])

At will (DC 15) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 16) - Blind, Charm, Mage Armor, Sleep, Wind Armor

2nd (DC 17) - Darkness, Grace, Poison, Silence, Wall Climb

3rd (DC 18) - Barrier, Blindga, Dispel, Haste, Immobilize, Infect, Slow

4th (DC 19) - Break, Disable, Frog, Hold, Mini

5th (DC 20) - Bioga, Blindja, Gravity, Poisonja, Zombify

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 10

Base Atk +7; CMB +7; CMD 21

Feats Bouncing Spell, Combat Casting, Disruptive Spell, Dodge, Extra MP, Improved Initiative, Silent Spell, Spell Focus (Enfeebling)

Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +13, Diplomacy +13, Disguise +13, Escape Artist +16, Knowledge (Geography) +18, Knowledge (Local) +18, Knowledge (Nature) +18, Perception +16, Sense Motive +16, Use Magic Device +13

Gear quarterstaff +1, top hat, 5000 gil;

Languages Common, Mithran, Sylvan

SQ Enfeebling Arts, Greedy Feedback

description.value: All enfeebling spells' effects are increased by a +3 penalty of the appropriate type. All enfeebling spells' durations are increased by 3. All enfeebling spells' caster level are increased by 3. The caster level checks made to overcome a creature's spell resistance is increased by 3 for enfeebling spells.

contextNotes.text: Enfeebling spells only: +3 severity to existing numeric penalties. Individual spells already include the caster-level and duration adjustments.

description.value: The greater cait smell the gil on his opponents. He'll usually target the person with the most gil and for every 1000 gil his opponent has increase his physical damage and attack bonus by 1.

effect: Sense gil within 120 ft. Per 1000 gil carried by current foe, +1 physical attack and damage. Re-evaluate on target change.

damages.raw: 1000 gil his opponent has increase his physical damage

description.value: The greater cait can pay an ally gil to increase their physical and magical damage by 1 per 1000 (Max 3) for 5 rounds.

effect: Spend 1000 gil per +1 to physical and magical damage (max +3) for five rounds.

description.value: As a standard action, the greater cait may touch up to five items weighing up to 5 lbs., which begin to levitate in its space for the next 5 rounds. Immediately, and once per round as a standard action thereafter, it can launch one item at a target of its choice. The ranged attack is made as if you had thrown the item unless it's ammunition for a weapon, in which case the attack is made as if fired from a heavy crossbow (if a bolt), a halfling sling staff (if a sling bullet), a blowgun (if a blowgun dart), a composite longbow with a +2 Strength rating (if an arrow), an atlatl (if an atlatl dart), or a pistol (if a firearm bullet). A firearm pellet launched by the spell functions as a shuriken. When you launch ammunition with this spell, you don't take a penalty on your attack rolls for lacking proficiency with the ammunition's weapon; you do, however, take the usual -4 penalty for throwing an improvised weapon if you launch an item not intended to be used as a weapon. The attack roll uses your caster level in place of your base attack bonus and your Intelligence or Charisma modifier (whichever is higher) in place of your Dexterity modifier. Range increment and proficiency penalties apply as normal. The attack has an effective Strength bonus, if applicable, equal to the higher of your Intelligence and Charisma modifiers. The spell is discharged when all touched items have been launched. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).
